scope.policy: Domestic NEW unconditional integer KRW product price for exact reviewed sale unit. Exclude shipping and promotional/conditional discounts.
scope.networkActions: Public HTTPS GET only; no order/cart/login/account operations

existingModelReferenceWithLegacyReviewed.reason: Preserve already reviewed legacy price separately while physical sale variant/role migration is reviewed.

summary.stockCountsNotEstablished: No307 live seller-stock survey.6 active regular listings reobserved,9 unsupported price sections need markup checks. No mapping or no supported price section does not prove global stock/discontinued.

existingReuse.observationDatesMeaning: Existing74 snapshots are dated2026-10-06/08/09UTC. Reuse retains recorded timestamp and does not imply live refresh today.

requests.meaning: 1.1s is repository throttle, not a provider-published allowance.

rules: Strict manifest schema1 and1..1000items; unique positive Danawa pcodes/canonical URLs
Only BUILDCORES product source and DANAWA offers
Exactly one active div.box__mall-price; one explicit data-base-price and active matching pcode bridge per regular row
Use minimum of supported visible ordinary rows; shipping amount and conditional/cash offers not added
Preserve original offer verifiedAt; fresh observedAt after HTML retrieval
limitations: Does not discover pcodes or automatically verify numeric SKU, timing, revision, role, or manufacturer-page identity; review evidence is typed text/URLs only
MANUFACTURER products and SamsungCNH seller pages require separate path; existing importer supports these identities but Danawa collector does not
inStock means active listing, not warehouse stock or retailer checkout confirmation
HTML failure is a typed collection failure, not global unavailable
Default importCatalogPrices reads bundled72 snapshots, not arbitrary newly generated JSON
checks: Partial failure exit2 retains successful payload; never replace failure with zero/cache prices
Product source IDs,offer equality,sourceURLs,saleSku/saleUnit/moduleCount,NEW/inStock,true positive integerKRW,verifiedAt preserved/observedAt refreshed
File creation never modifies MySQL; import is a separate explicit step outside this audit
collector.ramSingleModuleContract: All RAM imports currently use RAM_KIT and exact RamSpec.moduleCount, including1 for a one-module item.

pipeline.action: Reuse74 snapshots. Refresh72 known Danawa mappings in one sequential process and separately review2SamsungCNH exact seller pages.
Resolve6 known-pcode outliers by exact seller SKU/product-price check; retain high factual prices if independently established, never use cheaper bulk/overseas variants.
Review exact SKU, packaging/revision, capacity, OC/RGB/timing and sale unit before regular-price collection.
Collect validated mappings; keep successful raw-HTML facts and typed errors. Distinguish no offer from markup/network failure; search snippets are discovery only.
Separate authorized import then product/API coverage reconciliation. This audit executes no DB/deploy.
